scope: Three-candidate original-method and metadata qualification for authorized P0; no new fitted policy, model, benchmark or mechanism-origin labels

correction.supersedes: Historical packet wording: intracellular CXCL9/single-cell FACS endpoint

candidates.title: Active learning-guided mechanistic modeling reveals context-specific regulators of CXCL9 expression in pancreatic cancer cells

endpoint.measurement: LEGENDplex capture-bead sandwich immunoassay PE fluorescence by FACS Symphony A3
endpoint.physical_flow_event: Capture bead; not a cultured cell or intracellular single-cell protein measurement

interventions.interpretation: Cross-context comparison also changes cytokine dose; off-target effects and toxicity limit target-specific causal attribution

replicate_design.paper_statement: Two independent biological screenings with technical duplicates for initial screening
replicate_design.candidate_hierarchy: File/run -> condition technical duplicate -> capture-bead events
replicate_design.source_support: Preprocessing recodes Sample1/2 as SampleA1/A2 and SampleB1/B2 before concatenation
replicate_design.culture_start_identity: Unresolved; biological screenings are supported by original methods
replicate_design.active_learning_repeat_hierarchy: Unresolved; A/B identifies cell context, not biological repeat

orthogonal_channel.candidate: EnzChek Caspase-3 activity after cell lysis using Z-DEVD-R110 substrate, plate fluorescence ~496/520 nm
orthogonal_channel.paper_correction: Sum separately normalized CXCL9 and Cas3 assays, then rescale 0-1; not validated secretion-per-live-cell
orthogonal_channel.access_result: PMC returned HTML reCAPTCHA despite HTTP 200; publisher mirror TLS failure; no archive members or outcome values read

evidence_level.prediction_validation: Potentially usable for context-specific perturbation-response validation after preserving screen/duplicate hierarchy and frozen held-out intervention plan
evidence_level.causal_explanation: Interventions can support response effects under suitable controls. Complete origin labels, compensation, stress and platform cause are not established. Orthogonal Cas3 is a conditional future candidate, not verified paired truth.
evidence_level.independent_units: Initial-screen biological run at most two per cell context, based on original method; beads and technical duplicates do not increase biological n
evidence_level.qualification: Initial endpoint and published repeat design qualified; novel discrepancy-origin benchmark not qualified

exact_method_excerpts.quote: averaged across two independent biological replicates with technical duplicates
across two independent wet lab screenings with duplicates per cell line
before retrieving the supernatant for the CXCL9 assay
We corrected for apoptosis by summing the normalized CXCL9 and Cas3 assay measurements (per assay), and rescaling these values to a range of 0–1

invalid_claims: Flow-event rows are independently cultured single cells
E3 and AL A/B suffixes share repeat semantics
MIDAS six-point grid is measured temporal evidence
All model nodes are measured proteins
Cas3 association identifies every discrepancy origin

candidates.title: Discovering the anti-cancer potential of non-oncology drugs by systematic viability profiling

endpoint.measurement: Luminex barcode-bead MFI from lysed cell pools; DMSO normalization, pool/plate QC and ComBat; replicate collapse

interventions.secondary_design: Eight-step four-fold dose dilution starting at 10 uM (approximately 600 pM final dose)
interventions.version_note: Official secondary README describes 489 cell lines and technical MTS010 redos; paper/landing counts must not be substituted silently

replicate_design.qualified_assay_repeat: Three independently treated assay plates, one to three retained after QC, within one screen
replicate_design.plate_pools: 25 barcoded cell lines per pool, frozen assay-ready vials, triplicate plating at 1250 cells/well
replicate_design.culture_start_identity: Separate independent thaw/culture starts unresolved, but this does not negate qualified independent treatment-plate repeats
replicate_design.technical_redo: MTS010 is explicitly technical redos and was not in the original preprint analysis

exact_method_excerpts.quote: Vials were thawed, and one pool was immediately plated per 384 well assay plate at 1,250 cells/well in triplicate
After a five-day incubation, cells were lysed
Up to 3 independently treated plates (range 1–3 based QC filtering) in one screen are median-collapsed to generate the collapsed log fold-change data matrix
Technical redos for 147 previously screened oncology compounds have been added as of 11/22/2019

evidence_level.prediction_validation: Independent treatment-plate assay repeats are supported; new functional replicate validation still requires actual replicate outcomes and a frozen evaluation design
evidence_level.causal_explanation: Screened compounds are interventions, but mechanism/target annotations are not validated per-response causal origin labels. Selected paper knockout/rescue follow-ups are separate mechanistic experiments.
evidence_level.independent_units: Treatment plate/repeat within screen for assay reliability; held-out screen, compound or context unit depends on specified generalization claim and dependencies
evidence_level.qualification: Functional endpoint and treatment-plate repeats qualified; matched molecular-to-functional bridge and origin labels unqualified

invalid_claims: Readout beads are independent biological samples
Median-collapsed values preserve raw replicate uncertainty
MTS010 technical redos establish independent biological subjects
Shared compound/cell IDs establish matched L1000-to-viability mechanism
Schema absence alone disproves assay repeats
Mechanism-of-action annotations are causal truth for every response

candidates.title: A Bayesian active learning platform for scalable combination drug screens

endpoint.analyte: Normalized Alamar Blue metabolic viability proxy
endpoint.readout: Cytation 5 fluorescence 555/20 nm excitation and 596/20 nm emission

interventions.acquisition_unit: Physical combination plate under cell-line availability constraints; three plates for each of three available cell lines per adaptive batch

replicate_design.rounds_11_15: Duplicate physical plates; wells with duplicate difference >0.5 viability flagged
replicate_design.culture_start_identity: Unresolved; plate repeats must not be described as verified independent biological culture starts
replicate_design.retrospective_distinction: Replicates averaged and synthetic plate groups constructed for replay; not prospective physical-plate provenance

exact_method_excerpts.quote: in rounds 11–15, plates were run in duplicate and quality control checks flagged wells whose duplicates differed by more than 0.5 in viability
After incubating cells in drug for 72 h

evidence_level.prediction_validation: Potentially suitable distinct combination-drug decision task after source schema and round-wise evaluation qualification; this audit downloads no outcome data
evidence_level.causal_explanation: Adaptive response prediction and selected biological rationales do not supply verified mechanism-origin labels or a matched L1000 bridge
evidence_level.independent_units: Prospective physical plates and batches under availability/round dependencies; duplicate plates qualify measurement repeats, not culture-start independence
evidence_level.qualification: Published assay timing and acquisition design qualified; new task outcomes/schema and independent culture starts unresolved

invalid_claims: Assay is an unqualified 72-hour direct survival measurement
Synthetic replay plates are prospective physical experiments
Duplicate plates necessarily mean independent biological starts
Dataset API contains tiny metadata tables rather than outcome matrices
Target-class annotations are validated mechanism truth

design_qualification.current_status: Metadata and published assay-repeat designs qualified to the stated level; discrepancy-origin identification not demonstrated
design_qualification.allowed_p0_use: Descriptive archived-prediction selection diagnosis and source qualification
design_qualification.distinct_channel_candidate: Matched CXCL9/Caspase-3, conditional on culture/well/time pairing and discriminating intervention design
design_qualification.functional_task_candidate: PRISM plate-level or BATCHIE prospective task with independent protocol and outcome access qualification

limitations: Publication methods support design, not implementation correctness of MAESTRO
No new functional outcome panels opened
No statistical superiority, novel mechanism or framework-effectiveness claim follows from this source audit
Failed retrieval is recorded as unresolved availability, not absent biology
